title: A Capricorn's 5-year plan has a 10-year plan.
old_caption:
Does your five-year plan have a ten-year plan?
Capricorn learns the summit is better when the whole team climbs together.

title: Which twin is up at 3 AM?
old_caption:
Awake at 3 AM worried that quiet you is boring?
Gemini's twin says you are not boring, just tired. Both sides of you are real.

title: POV: a Gemini's brain at 7 AM: 47 tabs.
old_caption:
Is your brain already at 47 tabs when you wake up?
Gemini closes them one by one until only "today" is left. One tab at a time.

title: A Gemini at a party knows everyone.
old_caption:
Are you the friend who says hi to everyone at the party?
Gemini knows thirty-one people and still came to see one friend.

title: Dating a Gemini: you'll never be bored.
old_caption:
Dating someone who never runs out of things to say?
Gemini sets a new record: one full minute of just listening.

title: A Gemini explaining their six side hustles.
old_caption:
Got six side hustles and a slide for each one?
Gemini has no extra time, just a lot of curiosity. That counts as a superpower.

title: A Leo at 3 AM: did they like me?
old_caption:
Lying awake wondering if people like you or just the show?
Leo's friends are up at 3 AM too, proving it. You're loved offstage.

title: POV: a Leo's morning lighting check.
old_caption:
Need a ring light and a pep talk to start the day?
Leo switches off the lamp and stands in the sunbeam. Shine for yourself first.

title: A Leo hypes every friend like a headliner.
old_caption:
Got a friend who shows up with a glitter sign for your big moment?
Leo hypes Sag at open mic, then hands back the spotlight. Your friends are stars too.

title: A Leo in love is a whole parade.
old_caption:
Is your dream wedding a full marching band and twelve confetti cannons?
Leo learns a smaller party still holds the same size heart.
